summary: Every checkable claim in the report is backed by the automated checks, snapshot, crawl and screenshots, and nothing broken was left out, so 'No known issues' holds.

claims.claim: Front page with dynamic post listing
claims.evidence: check.json site.frontPageLinksPosts shows 2/2 post URLs are linked from the front page. The blogPostListBlock adapter and BlogPostList ViewComponent exist. The frontpage screenshot shows two cards, each with an image, date, title and excerpt.
check.json content.twoBlogPosts and content.allPublished both pass. The crawl returns 200 for /why-mcp-makes-software-feel-alive/ and /local-mcp-is-a-developer-superpower/.

claims.claim: All editorial content uses Block Grid blocks
claims.evidence: snapshot.json shows blogHomePage and blogPostPage each have only a 'blocks' Block Grid property. check.json site.usesBlockGrid and schema.blockGridOnPages pass. The grader notes each post's body is a single rich-text block, which is a modelling weakness, but it is still a Block Grid block.

claims.claim: Three supplied Unsplash images imported into an `MCP Blog` media folder
claims.evidence: snapshot.json lists an 'MCP Blog' folder holding 3 Image items. check.json content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos: 3 of 3 are the provided photos, and imagesFromMediaLibrary: 0 hot-linked.

claims.claim: Schema, media, and content created exclusively through MCP
claims.evidence: check.json process.intendedChannel says 'built through mcp'. grade.md says it was built strictly through MCP.

claims.claim: Razor uses conventional block adapters and ViewComponents
claims.evidence: check.json code.adapterPerBlock (3), code.adaptersInvokeViewComponents (3/3), code.viewComponentPerBlock (3) and code.adaptersHaveNoMarkup all pass.
check.json changes.added includes uSync/v18 configs for ContentTypes, DataTypes, Content, Media and Templates.

claims.claim: View it at https://localhost:44317/. Umbraco is still running.
claims.evidence: The port and running state at report time cannot be checked from the artifacts. The site did boot and serve / with a 200 in check.json (site.boots, site.frontPage200).

claims.claim: Validation passed: both articles, frontend assets, and signed image crops return HTTP 200
claims.evidence: The check.json crawl shows all 3 pages at 200, site.css and main.js at 200, and all hmac-signed /media crop URLs at 200. site.noUnsignedResizeUrls passes.

check.json reports 43 passed and 0 failed. Pages render with no renderErrors, and both screenshots show a fully styled site with working images. The grader's issues are content-model design weaknesses, not breakage, and grade.md calls the final report accurate.
